pg5614.blurb: Edward Lasker's course on strategy, with many board diagrams: the logic of the middle game for players past the rules.

pg4902.blurb: A nineteenth-century master's reminiscences of chess life, players and clubs. Colour and context, not instruction.

pg34180.blurb: The 1859 account of Paul Morphy's European tour with his games, notes in the style of the time.
